story: Apollo 11 Had a Hidden Hero: Software
text: "The Charming Genius of the Apollo Guidance Computer" is a wonderful talk: [VIDEO] The AGC implemented a virtual machine to run higher-level computational routines. The whole architecture is really interesting.

story: The Charming Genius of the Apollo Guidance Computer [video]
text: The part about core rope memory was pretty interesting. Star charts and other bits of data were actually woven into a form of read-only memory via loom: [VIDEO] [LINK]

story: In 1975, the USSR fired a cannon from an orbiting space station
text: I was going to say much of the same, but I won't echo you. I just recently watched this really interesting video from London Code Mesh 2015 on the Apollo Guidance Computer where the radar antenna-generated interrupts were discussed (among other interesting bugs). [VIDEO]
A not so inspiring talk about a very inspiring topic. A much better talk about the Apollo guidance computer was held at Code Mesh London 2015: [VIDEO]
